card.name: Genetic defect and abnormality descriptions
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in gene or syndrome descriptions, just before a defect or abnormality term is expected, such as after 'abnormal', 'microcephaly', or 'including'.

modes.label: Inside abnormality names
modes.description: Parts of gene names containing abnormal or microcephaly.

modes.label: Linking words before defects
modes.description: A comma or linking word that leads into a list of abnormalities or effects of a gene loss.
modes.example: Robinow syndrome,<< including>> genital abnormalities and heart defects.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning defects, such as '缺陷' and ' defects'.
card.plain: It fires in genetics text just before a defect or abnormality is named.
